rows.note: Keep the displayed affine Spec presentation as written. The supplied row proposes a mathematical replacement involving the free B_{2^m}, a finiteness condition and an ind-scheme; these are a refinement, not missing manuscript text, and were not independently proved here. This is an optical refinement only, not a refutation of the proposed mathematical correction.
